name: Six Senses Vana
insider_take: Nestled in the pristine Sal forests of Dehradun, Six Senses Vana is India's premier wellness sanctuary where ancient Ayurvedic traditions meet cutting-edge holistic therapies.
whats_special: This 21-acre forest retreat sits at 2,200 feet elevation in the Himalayan foothills, featuring India's first RoseBar cryotherapy chamber and a unique blend of Ayurveda, Tibetan medicine, natural healing, and yoga. The property's architecture seamlessly integrates with the natural Sal forest canopy, and it's one of the few wellness resorts globally to offer personalized programs based on individual dosha assessments.
pro_tip: Book the signature "Panchakosha" program - a transformative 7-day journey addressing all five layers of human existence according to ancient Vedantic philosophy. It's exclusively available here and includes personalized Ayurvedic consultations.
dont_miss: The treetop yoga pavilions for sunrise sessions, the organic farm-to-table dining experience at the main restaurant, and the sacred Ganga Aarti ceremony in nearby Rishikesh (just 45 minutes away) - considered the yoga capital of the world. The resort also offers helicopter transfers with stunning Himalayan views.
pros: World-class wellness and spa programs with holistic healing approaches
Serene forest location in the Himalayan foothills offering natural tranquility
Sustainable luxury practices and eco-conscious design philosophy
Personalized wellness journeys with expert practitioners and nutritionists
cons: Remote mountain location requires longer travel time
Wellness-focused environment may not suit leisure-seeking guests
